title: answers blocking projection (v1)
description: The stable projection of one blocking answers success inside the JSON envelope's data.projection: the answer text (omitted when the response offered none), the citation count, and the citations the response carried with their usable members. The lossless chat-completions document rides data.upstream and the header-observed usage counters ride meta.usage.

answer.$comment: The first choice's message content; omitted when the response carried no usable answer text.

citation_count.$comment: The number of citation entries the response carried.

citations.$comment: The response's citations in document order; empty when it carried none.
